A byte measurement above recorded.bytes * (1 + regressionToleranceRatio) or max.bytes fails. Zero tolerance rejects even one byte of growth. Version v3-hpl records exactly 24,342 additional fixed bytes versus v2, independently reproduced from the source base revision and attributed below; the synthetic audit-event byte increments are unchanged. All absolute byte budgets are unchanged. stringifyMs, parseMs and doubleCloneMs are the informational local measurements from this revision; their historical maxima remain informational and never decide acceptance. Missing, duplicate or invalid workloads/samples and missing, malformed or mismatched baselines fail closed. This synthetic byte gate is not evidence of PostgreSQL WAL, locking, network latency, staging load or production p95 acceptance. Raise a byte threshold only with a measured reason recorded in this file.
